# Upstream provenance

This runtime is derived from **DeepSeek Harness for Codex** by `Seann0824`, upstream package version `0.3.1`, distributed under the MIT License.

Repository: `https://github.com/Seann0824/deepseek-harness-for-codex`

The original upstream design provides a Codex plugin/MCP server that starts or reuses a local DeepSeek Harness web service, creates visible sessions, delegates runs, and lets Codex inspect results. Toharness vendors a compatible derivative rather than requiring the external plugin at runtime.

See `UPSTREAM_SOURCE_MANIFEST.json` for upstream Git blob identifiers used for provenance.
